title: Regulatory report scheduler: PDF/CSV exports, dashboard slices, and delivery SLAs
creator: Maya Chen
description: Enable scheduled generation and secure delivery of compliance reports (PDF and CSV) and curated dashboard slices for customer audits. The feature must respect data residency and retention settings per-tenant, provide retry/delivery guarantees, and include an audit trail (who requested, what was sent, where) exposed in Console and via export logs.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can create a scheduled report that exports a PDF or CSV on a cron-like cadence (daily, weekly, monthly)
Export pipeline respects tenant residency: data for EU tenants is generated and stored in EU region; US tenants in US region
Retention policy applied: exported artifacts older than tenant retention window are automatically purged from object storage and Console listings
Delivery targets: scheduled reports can be delivered to e-mail, S3/GCS bucket, or SFTP with retry logic and 3 delivery attempts documented
Dashboard slice configuration: PM can point scheduled report to a saved dashboard view (time range, filters) and capture the snapshot in PDF
Audit log entries for each export include timestamp, initiator (system or user), region, file URI, and delivery status
API + Console parity: same configuration options available via Redwood API and Console UI
Security: exports contain no plaintext secrets and adhere to tenant encryption keys (KMS/HSM) when required

risks: Large tenant exports may spike network egress costs; need cost guardrails and optional sampling
Region-misconfiguration could cause cross-border data leakage if bucket selection fails
Deliverability to customer SFTP endpoints may vary; require clear SLA and health checks
PDF snapshot rendering brittle for complex dashboard widgets; fallback to CSV or raw data export required
implementation_notes: Use existing export worker pattern and extend to be region-aware (worker picks storage/bucket based on tenant.residency)
Store generated artifacts with tenant-scoped prefixes and KMS encryption when tenant requires customer-managed keys
Signed access links expire per tenant retention policy; retention purge job will reconcile object storage and Console metadata daily
Delivery subsystem should emit structured telemetry: export_id, tenant_id, region, bytes, duration, attempts, final_status
UI: expose schedule cron-preview, residency hint, last-run status, and manual run button
Expose a /reports API to list, trigger, and fetch exports programmatically with RBAC checks
